title: Parse typed quantities behind a wrapped boundary
task: Package `qty` parses quantities that users type, such as `3`, `3 pcs`, and `2.5 kg`, into a value with an amount in thousandths (so 2.5 becomes 2500) and a unit (`pcs` when omitted). The standard library's number parsing errors must not reach callers; they get one error type of ours that says which text was rejected. Keep the standard library conversion calls confined to one small spot. Test each form and a rejection.
